text: On a remote farm in Iceland, María and her husband Ingvar watch one of their sheep give birth to [a lamb-headed child with a human body|images|monsters and hybrid creatures]. They name her Ada and [raise her in place of the daughter they lost|who_suffers|the grieving], while the ewe lingers outside the house until María kills her and buries her body. Ingvar's brother Pétur arrives and calls Ada an animal, the family dog is killed, and somewhere near the barn [something breathes loudly in the dark|threat|monsters and creatures].
